description: A datetime input or query property reads the timestamp JavaScript's toISOString() builds (2026-10-14T09:30:00.000Z) as the instant it names, in a list too, its validation rule accepting exactly what its cast reads, while a property with its own #[DateFormat] or #[WithCast] format keeps only that format; the form built with toISOString() and its Contracts pass the full ci:check.
